caseStudy.blurb: Top to bottom refresh of the Agility Robotics brand identity. As the internal designer on the visual identity team, I worked closely with our Visual Brand Director to define the new visual language and strategy — a new proprietary typeface, a rebuilt logo and wordmark system, a core color palette, and the application of all of it across apparel, print, signage, and product photography.
